runtime_license_boundary.detail: The strict MIT/Apache-2.0 Cargo package audits and selected-source guards pass without exceptions. The known futures-channel BSD queue was replaced by an original synchronized FIFO. Bundled OpenSSL excludes the separately noticed SipHash implementation through no-siphash and no-quic; old and failed single-option binaries are rejected by the exclusion gate. Current static core 1e024f35 passed 33 container and 29 HTTPS checks. It still contains non-allowlisted Rust Unicode data, while libc, unwind, compiler-builtins and startup inputs remain incompletely reviewed. Combined-option GNU candidate d7d42ac4 passed startup, numerical, TLS, native byte capture, mapped-source and compiler-notice checks, plus 33 container and 29 HTTPS checks on separately owned runtime infrastructure. All 927 mapped native bodies remain available by verified hash after cleanup. All 107 bodies without byte-identical package candidates were regenerated exactly from the verified locked OpenSSL archive; selected generator/template notices still require file-level review. It has no retained SipHash symbols or objects. Its external std contains non-allowlisted components that must not be bundled. Individual-file exceptions, unmapped or inlined content, external-runtime distribution and production adoption remain uncleared. See licensing.md and runtime-link-audit.md.

jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 106 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Current core 1e024f35 passed 33 container and 29 HTTPS checks, including active FFmpeg shutdown, video resume and embedded metadata persistence after restart. Bounded embedded music display fields import automatically after scans, with current file identity, provider precedence and unknown-credit isolation checks. Both official web and Qt 6 Desktop displayed tagged titles/discs and completed the four-track original FLAC album queue with automatic advancement, fifteen successful playback responses per client and exactly one added play per track without a state reset. Web active audio and Desktop audio EOF were observed. Exact web options delivered byte-identical original FLAC. The backend upgrade preserved grants, identity, media state, playlists and favorites. Earlier studio, native-video failures and client controls retain their exact image scopes in acceptance.md. Public Jellyfin 12 observations support embedded fields, studio filename precedence, stored folder sorting, music state and artist roles/counts. Automatic tag-named artist and album creation, embedded images, wider tags/formats, ambiguous names, complete recommendation and collection management, studio artwork and virtual enumeration, played-state writes and full Jellyfin 12 behavior remain incomplete. General Desktop startup, broader clients, native AAC, arbitrary seeking, audible quality and scale remain unvalidated. Native final-position inconsistency remains unexplained; some user-data writes retain qualified differences from the reference.

feature_acceptance.detail: Feature areas remain partial. See compatibility.md for individual limits.

external_client_and_remote_security.detail: 29 local HTTPS proxy checks passed with synthetic remote addresses. Internet deployment, broader external-client behavior, proxy configurations, and external security review remain incomplete.

operational_scale.detail: Bounded 20,000- and 99,000-file synthetic scanner runs passed. No real-storage 1 PB, billion-file, or thousand-stream load result is available.
